Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.implicit

Class LegacyImplicitAuthorizationRequestConverter

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.implicit.LegacyImplicitAuthorizationRequestConverter
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.springframework.security.web.authentication.AuthenticationConverter
public class LegacyImplicitAuthorizationRequestConverter extends Object implements org.springframework.security.web.authentication.AuthenticationConverter
Reads an authorization request with response_type=token. The framework refuses that response type; this converter, installed first, takes it over for the one client of the legacy flow and refuses it, with the same unsupported_response_type and no redirect, for any other client.
